description: This file provides middleware and utility functions for auditing actions within a Node.js application. It includes a function to write audit logs to a database and a middleware to automatically record audit entries for HTTP requests.

methods.name: writeAudit({ entity, entityId, action, performedBy, details })
methods.description: Asynchronously writes an audit log entry to the AuditLog database table, capturing entity, action, performer, and optional details.

methods.name: auditTrail(entity, action)
methods.description: Creates Express middleware that logs audit information for HTTP responses, triggered upon request completion if certain conditions are met.

ctags.name: writeAudit
ctags.pattern: /^async function writeAudit({ entity, entityId, action, performedBy, details }) {$/
